justifications.durability: The new module pins next-element adjacency of the three metas through a real write_plan, first-wins in both copy orders through read_state and parse_meta with the duplicated names in the warnings, and meta-order preservation for a scattered document; the declared mutation reddens four of them at the base revision, so the guard is shown to fire rather than merely not to; the block writer is single-sited so no second emission path can drift.
justifications.evidence: Every arm is captured with a header naming the revision, tree, literal command, resolved cwd and module as imported, each closing on a bare EXIT= line; the declared negative control fires at the base revision (4 failed, exit 1, the swapped-copies case failing as assert 0.9 == 0.1); I independently re-ran the named gate at head (11 passed in 18.38s, EXIT=0) and derived added_failure_count=0 from base-181.log and head-181.log. Held because the base arm ran at 7dde3c88b, which is 52 commits ahead of the reviewed base 4d1feeed9 rather than at it, and the fragment's Reproduction table labels it 'the main revision this branch is stacked on' when the branch's parent is 4d1feeed9; the delta instrument still surfaces any introduced failure, but the provenance label is inaccurate. The arms are also not at tree parity (base in a scratch extraction, head in the worktree), which is why the three base-only dispatch-timing reds are recorded rather than attributed.
justifications.fit: Commit subjects are conventional with bodies stating what changed and why; none carries AI attribution or a plan/ticket identifier; the symbols name the mechanism (_set_meta_block, _metas_are_contiguous, lifecycle_block) with no section label; the added code is ruff-clean and the pre-existing findings in the touched file are unchanged.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The defect opens on reader/writer disagreement over a duplicated lifecycle scalar, and the repair removes it at the source: the writer converges a duplicated document to one copy on its next write, the reader names the same copy the writer maintains, and later copies are surfaced as warnings rather than silently dropped. Measured over the whole corpus by the population arms. Held below full because the chosen rule is first-wins dedupe rather than the refusal the Measure clause lists first -- a defensible reading of 'refuses or dedupes deterministically', and a wider background change to non-plan meta names, but not stated as a deliberate choice for those.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff is exactly the three declared paths, 480 insertions and 8 deletions; the store needs no source change because both its plan-write paths call write_state; no shared index, sprint or other plan is touched; no unrelated reformatting.
